data.title: FDA Completes Follow-Up Inspection of Xspray Pharma’s Manufacturer
data.description:
Xspray Pharma AB ( (SE:XSPRAY) ) has provided an update.

The FDA has completed its follow-up inspection of contract manufacturer NerPharMa’s Italian facility. The inspection produced a Form FDA 483 with observations, while NerPharMa confirmed that none specifically refer to Xspray’s manufacturing lines or production of Dasynoc® or Nilopki®.

NerPharMa has begun work to address the observations. The FDA has not yet determined the facility’s inspection classification, and the manufacturing site’s regulatory status remains unresolved.

data.title: Genius Group Reports Anthropic IPO and AI Treasury Holdings
data.description:

Genius Group is a global education group focused on AI-powered education and acceleration solutions for the future of work. Its offerings include AI training, tools and talent delivered through Genius City and an online marketplace to individual, enterprise and government users in more than 100 countries.

On November 20, 2026, the company updated shareholders after Anthropic’s November 19 Nasdaq listing, reporting that Anthropic represented about 21% of its AI Treasury and was its largest look-through holding. data.title: VisionWave Holdings Announces Agreement to Acquire CMIP
data.description:
An announcement from VisionWave Holdings ( (VWAV) ) is now available.

On November 18, 2026, VisionWave completed its acquisition from SofTech of MoreSpeed, an AI-accelerated forensic video search software system, including source code, trained models and related deployment assets. It issued SofTech a $4 million unsecured, non-interest-bearing note payable in a single installment on November 18, 2027, subject to completion of asset delivery and curing or waiver of material non-conformity.

On November 20, 2026, the company announced that it had signed an agreement with Litial on November 18 to acquire CMIP, although the acquisition had not closed. CMIP is designed to provide critical-minerals market intelligence, supply-chain transparency, regulatory screening and procurement-related information, initially focusing on tungsten and antimony.
